title: Sarah Sze: Rip Tide Poster

description.main: This poster reproduces a detail from Rip Tide (2025), a mixed-media painting Sarah Sze made for Sarah Sze, her first exhibition in Asia, at Gagosian, Hong Kong. A collaged image of a bird soars over a sweep of pink, orange, and gold paint echoing a flock of birds rising toward the top of the canvas.
description.extended:
Sarah Sze made Rip Tide (2025) for Sarah Sze, the exhibition that marked her first show in Asia, at Gagosian, Hong Kong; this poster reproduces a detail from the painting.

The exhibition, on view March 25-May 3, 2025, included new mixed-media paintings alongside a series of hanging sculptures. In Rip Tide, a collaged image of a bird soars over a sweep of pink, orange, and gold paint that echoes a flock of birds rising toward the top of the canvas, part of Sze's recurring interest in motion caught mid-transformation.

Sze (b. 1969) builds paintings, sculptures, and installations from layered images and objects, working between memory and material. In works like this one, recurring imagery surfaces and dissolves across the canvas the way details resurface and fade in memory. This record covers the unsigned poster; Gagosian also sold a version signed by the artist.
description.artist_bio: Sarah Sze (b. 1969, Boston) is a multimedia artist working across sculpture, painting, drawing, video, and installation, assembling objects and images from physical and digital worlds into environments that shift between microscopic and macroscopic scales. She has represented the United States at the Venice Biennale (2013) and received a MacArthur Fellowship in 2003.
description.exhibition_context: Sarah Sze at Gagosian, Hong Kong (March 25-May 3, 2025) was the artist's first exhibition in Asia, including new mixed-media paintings and a new series of hanging sculptures.

notes: Produced 2025 for the exhibition Sarah Sze at Gagosian, Hong Kong (March 25-May 3, 2025), the artist's first exhibition in Asia. Reproduces a detail from the painting Rip Tide (2025). Gagosian sold the poster in both unsigned and signed versions; this record is the unsigned poster. Companion Sze poster in this catalogue: Feel Free (id 80002, Gagosian Beverly Hills, 2026).
